guide.setup: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down to grip it just outside the legs, then brace the back and abdomen.
guide.execution: Push the floor away and keep the bar close to the legs. Stand tall by extending the hips, then guide the bar back to the floor.
guide.cues: Brace before the pull. Squeeze the armpits. Keep the bar close.
guide.mistakes: Jerking the bar; rounding the lower back; letting the bar drift forward; leaning back at lockout.

images.caption: Deadlift setup with hips hinged, back braced, and the bar close to the shins.
